slides.teacher_cue: Four word family endings to systematise. -age /eɪdʒ/: cage, rage, sage, stage, page (soft g, CVCe-like). -ice /aɪs/: price, twice, slice, rice, nice (soft c, CVCe). -ace /eɪs/: space, place, grace, race, face (soft c, CVCe). -idge /ɪdʒ/: bridge, ridge, fridge, wedge, edge (hard vowel + -dge rule). Students have met all these patterns — today consolidates them as families.
slides.expected_response: Students read and write -age, -ice, -ace, and -idge family words fluently.
slides.correction_move: Show each family as a column. Students read down each column, then across. Establish: these are word families — same ending, different onset.
slides.observation_note: Watch for hesitation on soft endings — should now be automatic.
